title: Global welfare cancels tariff terms of trade and gives an exact optimal charge
checked_scope: The interior two-country border-charge equilibrium and domestic equivalent-variation account, extended to equal-weight global welfare with a common climate-damage value.
significance: A complete global welfare formula yields a closed-form optimal charge and shows how foreign demand rebound changes the corrective charge even with a correct domestic carbon tax.
author: /root/new200_c
